pre_execution_revision: v1 produced only compile failures: selected HIP SDK warpSize is non-constexpr; explicit manual width32 specialization added before any GPU numerical result, with cases/tolerances unchanged
post_pilot_engineering_revision: After v2 pilots, backing allocations were padded to a full eight-row block to keep inactive tail-group pointer formation within allocated storage. Final harness compares padding sentinel bits (0x7fc12345); it does not prove absence of writes. Earlier pilots only tested NaN padding and their untouched label must not be used as a guarantee. Logical inputs, kernel/dispatch, 18 cases, reference and tolerances unchanged. Earlier reports retained.
